scope: Existing basic infected, Elizabeth Greene and Goliath. Supreme Hunter protected. Other draft bosses retired.
boundary: An animation index and bounded FIG parse are not proof of complete original AI, audio, contact or gameplay reproduction.

p2.limitation: Opaque conditions, TrackGroup internals and dynamic animation controllers remain. P1 payload field offsets must not be reused for P2.

species.sourceMapping: Candidate reference only: infected2 grab/reorient and jump attacks are not yet proven to be the same role as the current ordinary civilian. P2 infected1 shared behavior also indexed.
species.runtime: Authored segmented humanoid locomotion and three attacks. Source curves not yet bound.
species.next: Resolve common infected versus infected2 behavior, then retarget and test each hand against actual rendered wrists.

species.sourceMapping: Minecraft host-species adaptation; no one-to-one original creature established.
species.runtime: Existing host behavior and attached organ attacks.
species.next: Audit organ attachment during hit, grab, consume and death on biped, quadruped, flying and representative mod models.

species.sourceMapping: No verified one-to-one original species in this audit; do not label the authored animation as extracted.
species.runtime: Authored sharp-digit swept contact, right/left hit windows, committed airborne pounce, hull collision, real landing and existing spatial recorded cues. Every-tick tracking with one-step interpolation and bounded pounce tissue presentation.
species.next: Finish wall-contact limb recoil, silhouette/detail, hurt/death/consume choreography and full player/mod/network combat matrix. Existing model is not a verified extracted original species. Brute contact/charge is the next shared-runtime pass.

species.sourceMapping: No verified one-to-one original species in this audit; do not label the authored animation as extracted.
species.runtime: Animated head/torso mouth locators drive single and triple physical releases at the committed aim. Cover and blocked nozzles intercept shots. Flight/target-box surface contact owns one spatial splash; existing recorded tension/launch/burst cues are connected. Retreat checks walls and supporting ground. Both platforms: 14 relevant unit checks, 10 server scenes and 1097 total native frames; see art/mutant-combat/spitter-validation.json.
species.next: Species-specific hurt/death/consume choreography, silhouette/detail, audible mixing, moving-player/network/mod receiver matrix. Target impact currently uses native bounding boxes, not arbitrary skin triangles. No verified one-to-one original species.

species.sourceMapping: No verified one-to-one original species in this audit; do not label the authored animation as extracted.
species.runtime: Authored 152-cuboid anatomy with separated chest/scapulae, recessed maw, fingers/thumbs, knees and toes, reusing the existing atlas. The 120 upper-body cuboids drive swept right-fist hammer, supported two-fist slam/wave and committed charge with shared pose tables. Articulated elbows drive a dedicated 25-tick ground recovery; client fist descent is limited to known terrain until server contact arrives. Per-attack damage ledger, existing spatial cues, supported wall backstep, every-tick tracking and bounded charge presentation remain. Standing weapon-hit reactions now enter from the last rendered pose, cancel attacks immediately, retain surface-clearing elbow recovery across packet ordering, and explicitly release all channels to idle. Physical corpse entry preserves the last displayed Brute pose and suppresses duplicate Gecko death roll. Production hammer/blade lethal inputs and two mounted-consume completion flows have bounded native evidence. Mounted Brute sessions now retain the captured body heading through mount, hold and consume on server and client; actor confirmation cannot rotate the scene. Cancellation releases this heading ownership. Player hammer-quake recovery beside Brute now constrains the actually scaled fists after the final contact window while preserving hip/leg pose and server attack sweeps. Shared HammerGroundPose now constrains released hammer-quake fists to solid ground for both render and server contact. Corrected visible fist vertices must reach a real top face before the ground event; native flat charged-quake survival and subsequent jab death remain valid. Released hammer-quake support now follows each corrected vertex over actual collision columns. Ordinary and charged native flows cover flat ground, front slabs, a side block and a ledge; idle/charge/jab mesh overlap remains explicitly open. Brute mounted hold/consume now uses a planted native body and fitted support arms/raised knees, with original bone lengths and a free right strike arm. Stable claws/muscle hand meshes seat just outside actual torso geometry; independent native side/rear checks bound skin overlap, while exact choreography remains open.
species.next: Continue residual get-up translation, per-limb terrain support beyond the reviewed slab edge, body weight and self-contact. Knees now have anatomical physics limits and the authored rise is centered over the hips; hip/shoulder/elbow physics, ankle/finger articulation and exact palm contact remain open. Retain native getup interruption/death and side/rear/offscreen/network coverage, initial mount/seat/knee surfaces, attack contact/full consume choreography, hammer idle/charge/jab overlap, alternate skins/scales/final silhouette/materials, shield/mod combat and audible crowd mix. Full species/military/vehicle/item/audio goal remains unfinished.

species.sourceMapping: Original P1 Brawler source; canonical existing Hunter, 2500 actual HP.
species.runtime: Source frame schedules and wrist windows shared by server/render; contact and ground checks implemented.
species.next: Paired player combat, grappling/consumption and audible mixing still need their own acceptance.

species.sourceMapping: Original P1 Hydra source and FIG.
species.runtime: Source-calibrated slam/sweep/sidesweep share the rendered cuboids, all FIG windows and early turning. Timestamped body/ground/material-wall effects, shared hit ledger and obstacle recoil verified in both versions; gateway regression retained. Incoming current-model head/neck/jaw/horn/base proxies share parent health and native immunity; native ray/projectile, sword and three weapon-form sessions now use surface contacts with timestamped local feedback. Source object pickup/hold/throw is now connected to supported-ground material effects, articulated cargo, a swept rotating cube, accepted blunt contact feedback and cancellation. Dual-version frame and server checks are recorded in art/hydra/throw-validation.json.
species.next: Original regional armor/damage multipliers, complete AI/state conditions, prop template and release-branch index semantics, source audio waveforms, paired player absorb/hurt/death combinations, broader mod creatures, confined terrain and multiplayer latency remain.

species.sourceMapping: P2 infected3, with hammerer/slammer geometry variants indexed separately.
species.runtime: Own source two-hit combo, two-hand slam, block, block-hit and stun retargeted to existing mesh. Shared rendered fist contact, directional guard, poise break and actual terrain impact. Original oversized secondary hit events excluded from primary fist damage.
species.next: CHARGE still uses prior authored body-contact behavior. Original transition conditions, locomotion root travel, attack-type-specific armor sounds and player-facing balance require further work; no complete-original-AI claim.

species.sourceMapping: P2 flyer.p3d: 9 clips / 334 source frames, shoulder-elbow-wrist retarget. FIG controller references at 984801, 985329 and collision at 985865; opaque fields retain unknown semantics.
species.runtime: Source flight, committed accelerating dive, collision and front/back hurt. Swept authored body/wing cuboids, actual terrain contact, accepted damage once and visible-contact-gated blood/impact/audio. Existing 63 authored cubes preserved. Dual-version 148 checks each and 1837 native frames; see flyer-dive-validation.json. Receiving-surface checkpoint: native picking/projectiles, sword and actual Prototype server weapon sessions; 97 GameTests and 35 unit checks per version, 723 incoming and 1822 outgoing native frames; flyer-receiver-validation.json. Ordinary weapon receiver fixed: AI stun no longer erases source hurt; repeat hits restart/blend. 98 GameTests per platform, 1052 native weapon frames; flyer-weapon-validation.json. Server-owned live flyer physics: connected heavy body and receiving surfaces now share articulated snapshots, including terrain-constrained interpolation and confirmed landing effects. 100 GameTests and 37 contact unit tests per platform; 1108 native frames. See flyer-physics-validation.json. Native particle follow-up: 1108 fresh frames, shared contact_dust profile, confirmed tissue/impact/ground layers, corrected disposable observer billboard orientation; see contact-particles-validation.json. Native handoff checkpoint: 2679 fresh frames, actual weapon-draw anchor to native skin triangles, rigid blade contact, synchronized receiver facing, source wing folds, live release, sharp absorption and real lethal body capture; 41 focused units per platform. See flyer-handoff-validation.json; transitions and full terrain/network acceptance remain open.
species.next: Extend the verified two-sided native flyer thorax section to varied receiver rigs and sizes; smooth and verify physical knockdown→capture→hold→consume transitions, including terrain clearance and contact clocks; high-speed thin obstacles, network/crowds/mod matrix and remaining original audio. Whole species and active goal remain incomplete.

species.runtime: Source attacks plus verified independent appendages, configurable cyclic down state, rise/regrowth, persisted cycle progress and affine posed receiving surfaces. Entry/death and source sockets remain partial.
species.next: Complete entry/death choreography, calibrate source mouth projectile socket and validate radial wave cover; extend terrain, audio listening and multiplayer coverage.
